services.name: Niagara Falls Tour from Toronto Pearson Airport with Boat Cruise
Day Tour with Boat Cruise
services.desc: A flexible, lower-cost daytime route from Toronto, the Pearson Airport corridor, and Mississauga. Up-close Falls views, scenic Parkway stops, and free time - no boat cruise. A relaxed daytime route from Toronto built for travellers who'd rather skip the boat cruise - and the boat price - and spend more time on foot at the Falls. Pickup runs from Toronto hotels, the Pearson Airport corridor, and Mississauga in a comfortable coach. From there it's about ninety minutes south to Niagara. Your headline stop is Table Rock, the indoor visitor centre right at the brink of Horseshoe Falls. It's the closest you can get to the water without a boat and the best spot for photos with the American Falls
